signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

Why is Steve Wozniak giving away 800 ВТС for free?

Increasing the total mass of cryptocurrency in the world contributes to financial stability and prosperity of the economy as a whole, as well as of individual companies and people. More cryptocurrency means richer people and higher capitalisation for companies

Companies that hold free funds in cryptocurrency are protected from recessions, crises and bankruptcy. For example: for Tesla, bitcoin was a bigger moneymaker than cars. The electric car manufacturer has profited more from its $1.5 billion Bitcoin position in a single day than it did selling cars in Q4 2020.
So Steve Wozniak decided to encourage the spread of crypto in the world and is giving away 800 bitcoins for free. Anyone can get them!
